[모멘텀 지표]

· MACD 히스토그램 궤적 (0.0136→0.1334): 개선세 지속, 강세 추세 확산 신호
· 볼린저밴드 현재가 위치 (상단 $10.50): 상단 돌파 시도, 밴드폭 20.80% 확장 국면
[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($11.08): 현재가 상회, 지지력 확인
· 스윙 저항선 ($11.85): 단기 목표 저항 구간
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴 (Higher Low): 회복 추세 강화 신호
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (2.32배): 상승 움직임 신뢰도 상승
· 현 구간 진단 (상승추세): 11.08 지지 확인 시 추가 상승 기대, 11.85 돌파 시 레버리지 검토
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($11.18) vs SMA5/20/50 ($9.88/$9.51/$9.13): Short- to mid-term trend above, indicating bullish position.
· Price vs SMA100/200 ($10.36/$12.96): Mid- to long-term trend mixed, downward pressure present.
· 52-week position (8.6%) + Attempting to break out from historical low range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.9→65.3): Exited oversold, entered overbought, strengthening bullish momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0136→0.1334): Continued improvement, signaling bullish trend expansion.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Upper $10.50): Attempting to break upper band, band width expanding at 20.80%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($11.08): Above current price, support confirmed.
· Swing resistance ($11.85): Short-term target resistance zone.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Signal of strengthening recovery trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (2.32x): Increased confidence in upward movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Uptrend): Further upside expected if 11.08 support holds, consider leverage on breaking 11.85.
